description: Port Authority Trans-Hudson (PATH) Monthly Ridership: Beginning 1996 is a dataset listed in State of New York open data portal (data.ny.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of New York. Total Port Authority Trans-Hudson (PATH) system linked passenger trips, by month beginning 1996 through current year period. Trips are based on station turnstile entry counts. Coverage: New York State. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are transit, path, port authority of ny & nj, rail. The table has 3 columns. Attribution on the portal: Port Authority NY & NJ. The portal shows 2016-11-18 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-ny-gov-portal.
